sloka: तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च लक्षय ।चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः ।। ६.५९.५० ।।।।
transliteration: tasya cchidrāṇi mārgasva svacchidrāṇi ca lakṣaya ।cakṣuṣā dhanuṣā yatnādrakṣātmānaṁ samāhitaḥ ।। 6.59.50 ।।।।

translations.english: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."
